answer: The price of trying is 300 stamped dockets, each costing £38 to have checked, paid up front for every single name, while the voyage stays small. To join, a name must pass Foldbound land tax collector sheaf warrant, which works because a warrant collectors show after glebe trials. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The tally keeps ocean. The pearl is on the docket.
